# Kinetic energy marginals under bounded-variation amplitude modulation

Claim type: bounded_theorem

Claim status: conditional-support. The exact 464-line source has ordinary
analytic acceptance under its stated premises. This source-only assembly
preserves that source and its review evidence. It is not a publication,
formal proof certificate, independent audit verdict or retained promotion.

## Current scope

Fix the supplied massive free CAR model with m,v>0, two real compact smooth
spatial slots f,g, a carrier omega>2m, and finite resources tau_star, A_star
and V_star. For h=|lambda|>0, allow every 0<=T<=tau_star/h^2 and real BV
envelope A on [0,T] satisfying ||A||_infinity<=A_star and Var(A)<=V_star.
The envelope may depend on lambda and T. A fixed one-sided representative
handles jumps; changing isolated values has no dynamical effect.

For the drive lambda A(t)cos(omega t)V, write
J=lambda^2 integral_0^T A(t)^2 dt and nu_omega=(pi/2)r(omega), using the
exact pair-density normalization in M17 below. The result controls the
free-energy characteristic function and mean uniformly over these fixed
resources, with error O(sqrt(h log(2+h^-2))) for each fixed characteristic
test parameter. The comparison law is omega times Poisson(nu_omega J).
It also gives uniform W1 convergence to this parameter-dependent comparison
family without a claimed W1 rate. When J converges, the laws converge to the
corresponding single limiting law; the stated zero-rate cases remain included.

For slow-time modulation A(t)=a(lambda^2 t), T=tau/lambda^2,
J=integral_0^tau a(s)^2 ds and the Poisson intensity is nu_omega J.
These are one-time marginal laws. No joint
multi-time law, independent increments, inhomogeneous Poisson process,
trajectory convergence or repeated-measurement theorem is asserted.

The body also supplies the weighted full-input remainder, one-particle
operator estimate, finite-degree CAR bounds, necessary finite-mode rank
bound, and the distinct CAR, compact-Fock and global-state conclusions.
The rank bound is necessary, not an optimal detector construction. A finite
energy band or continuum spatial region is not automatically finite rank.

Zero envelopes, sign reversals, BV jumps and zero pair rates remain allowed.
No positivity for all nonzero controls is imposed. The strict carrier gap,
fixed positive mass, fixed spatial slots and fixed BV resources are material
premises. High-variation families, threshold/massless limits, optimal rates
and physical model selection remain outside the result.

## Actual-cell premise boundary and dependency status

The actual-cell conclusion assumes the real energy embedding, common free
energy and vacuum, and all M23 estimates: control-norm error, commutator
error, uniform commutator bound, and the explicit one-particle-generator
error. For epsilon_a=O(a^(N+1)) at fixed N, epsilon_a=o(h^2) is a sufficient
joint scale for the law, mean and W1 conclusion on bounded kinetic windows.
The weaker epsilon_a=o(h) suffices for the unweighted state/law comparison
only. The package constructs no new embedding, alias estimate or calibration.

The exact general470 and mean301 are bound to the published general compact-control
note; corrected859 is bound to the published two-zero note, and correlation335
to the published correlation note. Their four exact core maps give three direct
scientific parent nodes. These canonical notes are conditional-support, not retained.
The actual Git parent is regular PR 9516 at 0ce6e5ba7483d8ca14513b809009c7169c171a97. The [imports record](../.claude/science/physics-loops/toe-modulated-kinetic-energy-20261013/ASSUMPTIONS_AND_IMPORTS.md)
distinguishes these dependencies from review evidence and archived context.
M23 remains an explicit supplied-hypothesis transfer statement; source exposure
and Git ancestry do not create additional mathematical edges.

## Review and historical wording

The root plan was sealed at 10:22:14 UTC and primary464 at 10:53:33 UTC on
2026-10-13. The fresh review froze its plan before opening that new body and
its complete report/evidence at 11:11:33 UTC. Root acceptance followed at
11:14:22 UTC. The reviewer was already exposed to corrected859, correlation335,
general470 and their prior checks. Its distinct analytic BV calculations
are a source-exposed same-family check at the inherited model and effort,
not blinded or model-diverse verification. No new numeric or formal run
was used for this extension. This later packaging task is source-exposed.

The earlier 847-line kinetic source contained a genuine mixed-picture field
identity, missed by an earlier root consistency check. Fresh review found
it; the exact V2 correction and same-session confirmation closed it for V2.
The defective original, complete correction diff, review and root-miss
receipt remain archived. Historical pending wording in the proof and older
receipts remains unchanged; the current status is given by this wrapper
and the exact acceptance record, not by rewriting history.

The Fourier convention in the secular argument is
C_b(t)=integral b(e)exp(iet) de. Opposite correlation ordering reverses the
time argument; negative-phase correlation conventions cannot be substituted
silently into that argument. The full/interaction distinction is explicit
in M1--M2 and inherited from corrected859.
